description: This is a PHP source file defining the UserDao class within the OrangeHRM system. It provides data access methods for user-related operations such as saving users, validating user existence, retrieving users by ID or username, performing searches with filters, managing roles, and handling deprecated or soft-deleted users.

classes.name: UserDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing User entities in the OrangeHRM system, providing methods for CRUD operations, searching, role management, and user validation.

methods.name: saveSystemUser
methods.description: Persists a User entity to the database.

methods.name: isExistingSystemUser
methods.description: Checks if a system user exists based on provided credentials.

methods.name: getSystemUser
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity by its ID, if not deleted.

methods.name: getExistingSystemUserIds
methods.description: Returns an array of user IDs that exist within a provided list.

methods.name: getSystemUserIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all non-deleted system user IDs.

methods.name: deleteSystemUsers
methods.description: Performs a soft delete on users by marking them as deleted.

methods.name: getAssignableUserRoles
methods.description: Retrieves user roles that are marked as assignable.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Fetches a UserRole entity based on role name.

methods.name: getSearchSystemUsersCount
methods.description: Returns the count of users matching search filters.

methods.name: searchSystemUsers
methods.description: Performs a search for users based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeesByUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves employees associated with a given user role, with options to include inactive or terminated employees.

methods.name: isUserNameExistByUserName
methods.description: Checks whether a username exists, with an optional parameter to exclude a specific user ID.

methods.name: getUserByUserName
methods.description: Fetches a User entity by username.

methods.name: getDefaultAdminUser
methods.description: Retrieves the default admin user (created by null) with a password set.
